newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan May forex turnover at US$4.872 bln.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan May forex turnover at US$4.872 bln.

text.p: Average daily turnover on Taiwan's foreign exchange market in May totalled US$4.872 billion, the central bank said on Saturday.
The May forex turnover represented a 12.8 percent rise from April, but the central bank did not give year-on-year comparsion.

Of the daily turnover, 24.8 percent was between the U.S. dollar and the yen and 10.8 percent was between the dollar and the mark. Trade among the Taiwan dollar and foreign currencies accounted for 41.4 percent of the total.
Spot trading took 68.6 percent of the total, margin trading 11.4 percent, cross-currency swaps 10.4 percent, forward trading 7.4 percent, and options and futures 2.2 percent.
Taiwan started financial derivatives trading in early 1994.
